item.title: Version 3.3.0
item.description:
• PrayerTimes Pro is three things now — the living sky behind your countdown, every adhan reciter, and your streaks and qada. In the same pass the Siri "Next Prayer" shortcut, the adhan's volume and the pre-prayer announcement timings became free for everyone. Nothing you were already using has been taken away
  • The direct download stands alongside the Mac App Store again — the same app at the same price on either, so the channel is yours to pick
  • Bring your own muezzin — use a recording you already love, give each prayer its own reciter, and trim it to begin exactly where you want
  • A prayer-times widget for your desktop and Notification Centre
  • Your prayer log follows you between Macs through your own iCloud, with an export, a year in review, and an ambient clock for a second screen. Your preferences follow you too; what belongs to one machine stays on it
  • A desert that moves with the day behind the countdown — seven hours of light, drawn for this release — or your own photograph there instead
  • See how often you prayed on time, alongside the streak calendar and the qada ledger
  • Today's Prayer Times is available to Shortcuts, so you can build a morning routine around it
  • Alerts, spoken announcements and the adhan each keep the sound you chose for them, and quiet hours are one dial
  • A call-to-prayer recording that arrives damaged is discarded rather than kept, and a bundled adhan plays in its place
  • Your licence key no longer lingers in your clipboard history after you copy it

item.title: Version 4.1.0
item.description:
• Hero Size. Three hand-laid tiers of the Home hero — large, medium, compact — under Settings › Appearance › Popover, previewed live in the popover while Settings is open
  • Isha's window closes at the first third of the night rather than at Fajr; the check-in, the make-up ledger and the timeline all read the same boundary
  • Every screen of the popover scrolls instead of cropping, not only Streak
  • The Day Complete celebration rains confetti — strips, triangles, stars and diamonds, falling from the top edge
  • Plural notification bodies ("Prayer in 10 minutes", "Sunrise in 20 minutes") resolve the app's language rather than the registered default, and the window banner's countdown units are localized
  • The menu-bar title updates reliably under a fast tick (its subscriber throttles instead of debouncing)
  • Sessions are accounted for: a launch reports how the previous run ended — graceful, crashed or killed — to analytics on both channels, honouring the Diagnostics opt-out; the privacy manifest and App Store privacy details declare Crash Data
  • Debug builds gain a Notification Simulator window that checks authorization, alert style and sound before posting one of each notification the app sends

item.title: Version 4.2.0
item.description:
• A real moon. The night scenes draw tonight's astronomical phase (TinyMoon) instead of a cosine of the Hijri day, tipped by the observer's latitude and hour so the crescent leans at Makkah, smiles at the equator and mirrors in the south; a painted four-face surface sheet replaces the gradient blobs, and the terminator fades along its true ellipse
  • Tonight's phase glyph beside the Hijri date on Home; a Moon Phase card in the Hijri calendar with the illuminated fraction and the days to the next new or full moon, in all five languages
  • The Salawat reminder's default interval is 10 minutes (was 20) on a fresh install
  • About › Email reaches support@abd3lraouf.dev
  • Screens and actions are instrumented (`AppTelemetry`): one `Screen.viewed` event per surface, settings changes by key only, prayer marks by source — honouring the Diagnostics opt-out, with a test that every declared screen is reached from app code
  • Two bugs that made the analytics look empty: the injection-library check matched `ArgumentParserInternal` on the substring `gum` and marked paying customers as instrumented; and every Debug launch overwrote the installed app's session record so no abnormal exit was ever reported — the record is now per bundle path

item.title: Version 4.3.0
item.description:
• The sound channels are audible again. Re-adding a notification identifier that is already sitting in Notification Center is an in-place update — no banner presented, no sound played — and 280 of 282 Salawat deliveries over three days were exactly that, the pre-prayer announcement with them. Every reusable identifier now withdraws its delivered copy before the add, and the reminder is a clock-derived chain with rotating identifiers so consecutive fires are distinct deliveries
  • The Salawat clip is the app's, not the notification's. A `UNNotificationSound` answers to whatever Focus is active, to the alert style and the system alert volume, is capped at 30 s with the default beep as the fallback, and offers no volume control. The request is armed silent and the app plays the clip at fire time — once per fire, never stale after a sleep, deferred while the screen is locked
  • A clip of your own for the Salawat reminder — any audio file, copied into Application Support (not a security-scoped bookmark) and previewed on selection; it overrides Reminder Voice and falls back to the bundled clip if the file goes missing
  • Per-channel volume. The adhan, the announcement and the reminder no longer share one knob: each has its own key, synced between Macs, with its slider under the voice that speaks it. Volume is applied live to the clip already sounding via `UserDefaults.didChangeNotification` — the trim's fade-out is the one ramp a live change leaves alone
  • Prayer Check-In is a window, not a notification. `PrayerCheckInWindowController` + `PrayerCheckInView`: real buttons, a two-step answer with its own painted sky per outcome, Escape/Return, and no dependence on notification permission. Nothing is armed, so the scheduler asks the arithmetic on each tick which fire is behind the clock and presents once per answer — one question per fire, asked on wake if slept through, taken down when the prayer's window closes
  • A "What's New" sheet on the first launch after an update, spanning every release the user crossed, from `Resources/whats_new.json` in all five languages; afterwards from the app menu and Settings ▸ About. `WhatsNewTests` fails the suite when `MARKETING_VERSION` has no entry
  • Seventeen dead switches. "Show Sunnah Prayers" showed nothing, "Track Prayers & Streaks" off still wrote to the log, onboarding's two switches saved without rescheduling, Native Numerals never reached an armed banner, "Animate the Ambient Sky" was read once, and an iCloud settings push landed on disk and nowhere else — plus the widget and Shortcuts rendering in the wrong language, clock, digits and time zone; Hijri day correction never reaching Ramadan; Ambient Display observing one of its three gates; and the application main menu never re-localized
  • The Salawat chain under audit: no arming from the test host, a 60 s back-off on a refused `add`, the scheduler suspended before a quit's daemon wipe, the delivery grace measured from the last passed fire, and no plan holding two fires under one identifier across a DST spring-forward
  • Notification telemetry tells the truth: `in_center` distinguishes `responded` and `not_listed`, and `Prayer.fired` no longer claims `adhan_off` for Sunrise, `announcement_off` for the card-only pre moment or `no_banner` for the silent-by-design at-prayer banner
  • Debug builds gain a Sound Channels submenu (fire a reminder in 10 s or ~2 s, play either clip, withdraw debug fires, copy chain diagnostics), a Prayer Check-In submenu, and two What's New rows including a simulated update
  • CI holds a machine-wide `flock` while the hosted app is under test, so two runs on the same Mac cannot fight over the test host

item.title: Version 4.4.0
item.description:
• The tip sheet opens on a painted rooftop at twilight, each tier says what it does, and there is a way out that isn't the Escape key
  • In Arabic, Farsi and Urdu the tip sheet lays itself out from the right, so the words and the layout finally read the same way
  • The What's New sheet and the welcome guide open on the screen you are working on, instead of one you may not even be looking at
  • The countdown and the prayer name hold their contrast over the daylight scenes, not only the dark ones
  • A tip tier always shows its price, even before the store has answered

item.title: Version 4.5.0
item.description:
• The setup guide introduces the app, then thanks the people who paid for it. Six tour pages after setup — the three sound channels (each explained and audible, with the reciter chosen right there), streaks and qada, the living sky and your own photo, Qibla, the Hijri calendar and Ramadan, and a closing page naming the widget, Shortcuts, Ambient Display, iCloud sync and the Fajr warning. Skippable in one click from any page. A Pro install ends on a letter rather than a closed window
  • The app introduces itself. The mark arrives, then the name, then the greeting — timed to the reveal sound's own waveform rather than to taste, so the logo lands exactly as the sound does. Page turns are heard as well as seen, honouring the Mac's setting for interface sounds and never sounding over an adhan you are auditioning
  • Confetti where it was owed — the moment of buying Pro, which had a crest and rings and none, and a supporter opening a new version
  • The welcome guide is a button in Settings ▸ General now, not a switch that needed a relaunch to take effect
  • Onboarding's previews tell the truth about what you have bought: the streak chip is drawn locked for a free install, exactly as the popover draws it, rather than showing seven week-bars that would never appear
  • Fixed in the same pass: a feature row whose icon was not a real SF Symbol and rendered blank, a photo picker with no label saying what it picked, a Qibla page that promised a distance it never showed, the accent swatches arriving after the button explaining them, and the progress dots popping into place instead of fading
  • Right-to-left chrome is corrected in onboarding and the What's New window. The audition triangles on the Sounds step mirror under Arabic, Farsi and Urdu — `play.fill` does not flip on its own, and beside right-to-left copy a triangle pointing into the text reads as rewind; the onboarding buttons now carry the same override the Settings rows already had. And the mock window controls stay at the physical top-left: macOS never mirrors close/minimise/zoom whatever the language, so these windows' traffic lights no longer move to the top-right in Arabic. Both pinned by pixel-differential render tests, each verified to fail against the unfixed code
  • Onboarding teaches the Prayer Check-In before it ever interrupts you. A new Prayer Tracker step sits between Configuration and Sounds: the enable toggle, and the *real* check-in card — the genuine `PrayerCheckInView` at its exact size, seeded with a live Dhuhr — where tapping "I prayed" or "Not yet" plays the real feedback face and its real dwell, then brings the question back. A pure demo: no prayer is recorded, no `CheckIn.answered` telemetry fires, and `.shared` is never touched. The card, both buttons and its rounded bottom sit above the fold (the scroll viewport ends at 529; the card spans ~132–524) in English and Arabic alike
  • The real check-in can no longer land on top of its own preview. The scheduler's `canPresent` now includes an `onboardingIsVisible` gate — a due question arriving while the guide is up is deferred, not dropped; `due` still names the fire, so it is asked the moment the guide closes
  • The Sounds step is retitled from "How it should sound" to "Sounds", pairing one feature screen with one feature screen; the flow is seven steps and the progress dots follow on their own
  • Two new localized strings across all five languages (`Prayer Tracker`, the "try it" hint); "How it should sound" left every table

item.title: Version 4.5.1
item.description:
• Refreshed the three App Store locales with six curated screenshots, including full check-in states and authentic color variants.
  • Updated the website with localized interactive check-in and appearance previews.
  • Kept curated screenshots safe from accidental replacement by the legacy renderer.

item.title: Version 4.6.0
item.description:
• Setup guide redesign. One dark stage with a live MacBook that simulates each step — a Maps window with your location, the real popover (following the chosen appearance, accent and scene), the real streak, Qibla and calendar screens, and a live, answerable check-in card. Google Flow illustrations where a screen cannot carry the subject; no graphic on pure settings steps. Baked flag badges, text that scrambles into the chosen language without replaying the flow, blur-in entrances, and a DEBUG step rail
  • One material app-wide. `MetalButtonStyle` (satin metal with grain, sheen and contrast-picked ink) and `GrainSurface` cards across onboarding, Settings, the popover footer, Streak, Qibla and the calendar; Pro is gold everywhere it is sold
  • Contextual Pro offer. A running feature gallery; the Settings drawer and popover upgrade page open on the feature that raised them, with the rest of Pro below; an Apple-style purchase section (one price on the button, visible Restore, Terms and Privacy); Scenes gated as a whole section under a glowing premium frame
  • Calendar, Qibla and hero. Larger calendar type, a Friday band, an animated today marker and a painted banner; a real Qibla empty state; a Hidden hero size; a contrast-safe accent countdown
  • Full-screen alert. Only reachable "Remind me in" options, in metal over frosted glass; rolling countdown digits; the simulator now covers every lead and moves the menu bar with it
  • Menu bar. The near-prayer colour is the accent, lifted for contrast against the actual bar and swept as metal; the icon follows it
  • No bells. Natural recorded UI sounds (water drop, rustling leaves) replace the system chimes, with a test that rejects system sounds in app code
  • Donation sheet rebranded as Abdelraouf Studios; `scripts/brand/bake-donation-kit.py` bakes the in-app medallions and the Polar product covers
  • Font Awesome icon set, cannon smoke that varies shot to shot, accent swatch ring fixed

item.title: Version 4.7.0
item.description:
• Nine new iqamah recordings (Pro): Mustafa Ismail, Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary, Farouk Hadrawi, Al-Masjid an-Nabawi, Omair Shamim, Suhail Al-Zinati, Mohamed Abu Gabal, Abdul Rahman Sobhy and Ahmet Recep Koç, cut and loudness-matched by `scripts/iqamah/trim-iqamah.py`, which records each source
  • Named for the reciter. `iqamah-al-haram` and `iqamah-qad-qamat` were both Mishary Alafasy and are renamed; `IqamahSound(stored:)` keeps a choice saved under the old names. Yasser Al-Dosari leads the picker; the short Mishary call is the only free iqamah sound
  • Selection hints with an info icon in Settings and onboarding for the short fragment, the Hanafi form, the Haram and Nabawi styles and Same as Adhan, in five languages
  • Pro-state fixes: Pro Simulation off after locked re-signs a legacy grant (Pro picks read back as the free default until relaunch); the ambient display no longer reads the entitlement mirror before it is written and draws the Pro scene

item.title: Version 4.8.0
item.description:
• The guide re-opens on what an update added. A `whats_new.json` release may name guide pages in a `"tour"` array; the first launch after that update opens them once, after the highlights sheet closes, and only for the releases that install actually crossed. Hooked to the window closing, so Esc and ⌘W count too
  • App Store set regenerated for 4.7.0's iqamah voices: a Flow-rendered MacBook with the real full-screen card keyed into its screen (`scripts/marketing/green-screen.py` finds the screen corners itself), three painted medallions, and recaptured colour fans and check-in states

item.title: Version 4.9.0
item.description:
• Menu-bar pills (Pro). Fourteen styles from the *Menu Bar Gallery* design — Gilded, Aurora, Liquid, Lantern, Glass, Ring, Lightbar, Type, Split, Dot, Neon, Sun Path, Skyline, Island — each drawing nine states (quiet → approaching → near → imminent → adhan→iqamah → iqamah → logged, and not prayed → window ending) resolved by one pure `MenuBarPillResolver`; Jumuʻah on Friday, Iftar/Suhoor while fasting, a missed-prayer badge, film grain on painted fills, a blur crossfade on every state change, static forms under Reduce Motion, the Animate switch and Quiet Hours. Hosted inside the status button (`setCustomContent`), with its own open state in place of the system highlight. Classic stays free
  • Settings ▸ Menu Bar. Its own pane: a live strip stepping through the states, a Preview menu to pin one, and a gallery of fifteen cards on real menu-bar strips; Menu Bar Style / Minimal / Always Show Icon moved here from Appearance
  • Onboarding. A menu-bar step after Appearance — Classic and all fourteen Pro styles with per-card blur-in, the MacBook camera zooming the whole mockup onto its menu bar (Complete too, now on the same pose so the item clears the notch); the guide follows light and dark appearance
  • State-aware Home hero. Eyebrow, name, figure and caption follow the pill's states: time to iqamah, "Now", logged ✓ with the countdown to the next prayer, time left to pray
  • Isha end by madhab (`IshaEndRule`: first third / Islamic midnight, following the Asr madhab until chosen) and an After Isha, Count Down To option (`AfterIshaCountdown`)
  • Fixes. Settings opens above the popover it previews; the location survives a locationd grant reset; one sound preview at a time; audition play marks optically centred
  • Tooling: `scripts/pbx-add-sources.py`; four Font Awesome glyphs (mosque, kaaba, snowflake, exclamation); Pro gallery Menu Bar slide

item.title: Version 4.9.1
item.description:
• Licence activation fixed. Activating a licence key works reliably again
  • Licence key card. The field takes typing again and shows your key in its groups as you type; if activation cannot finish, the card says why, with a reference you can copy or send to support
  • Your Macs. See every Mac your licence is active on, and remove one to free its place for another
  • Unlock celebration. Unlocking Pro now ends in a short celebration
  • Performance. The Pro page in Settings no longer keeps your Mac busy while it is open
